description: This file contains UI tests for navigation flows in the NowInAndroid app, using Jetpack Compose testing framework and Hilt dependency injection. It verifies navigation behavior, UI element presence, and interactions within the app's main UI.

classes.name: NavigationTest
classes.description: UI test class for verifying navigation flows and UI behavior in the app.

methods.name: firstScreen_isForYou
methods.description: Verifies that the initial screen displays the 'For You' tab as selected.

methods.name: navigationBar_navigateToPreviouslySelectedTab_restoresContent
methods.description: Tests that navigating between tabs restores the previous state.

methods.name: navigationBar_reselectTab_keepsState
methods.description: Ensures reselecting a tab preserves its state.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_doNotShowUpArrow
methods.description: Checks that top-level destinations do not display the up arrow.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showTopBarWithTitle
methods.description: Verifies the top bar shows the app name and tab titles.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showSettingsIcon
methods.description: Checks that the settings icon is visible on top-level destinations.

methods.name: whenSettingsIconIsClicked_settingsDialogIsShown
methods.description: Verifies that clicking the settings icon shows the settings dialog.

methods.name: whenSettingsDialogDismissed_previousScreenIsDisplayed
methods.description: Ensures dismissing the settings dialog returns to the previous screen.

methods.name: homeDestination_back_quitsApp
methods.description: Tests that pressing back on the home destination exits the app.

methods.name: navigationBar_backFromAnyDestination_returnsToForYou
methods.description: Checks that back navigation from other destinations returns to 'For You'.

methods.name: navigationBar_multipleBackStackInterests
methods.description: Test is ignored; intended to verify back stack behavior with multiple tabs.

methods.name: navigatingToTopicFromForYou_showsTopicDetails
methods.description: Verifies that selecting a topic from the 'For You' feed shows the topic details.
